tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get a page from the company's internal wiki by its page title. Use this for a wiki page by title. For a file at a web URL, use `fetch_document`. For a PDF on the local disk, use `read_document`. For a contract by its CT- ID, use `open_document`.

tools.name: fetch_document
tools.description: Download a file from a public web address (an http or https URL). Use this for a file at a web URL. For a wiki page by title, use `get_document`. For a PDF on the local disk, use `read_document`. For a contract by its CT- ID, use `open_document`.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a PDF stored on the local disk and return its text. Use this for a PDF on the local disk. For a wiki page by title, use `get_document`. For a file at a web URL, use `fetch_document`. For a contract by its CT- ID, use `open_document`.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open a signed contract from the contracts archive by contract ID (format CT-12345). Use this for a contract by its CT- ID. For a wiki page by title, use `get_document`. For a file at a web URL, use `fetch_document`. For a PDF on the local disk, use `read_document`.
